name: evoclaw-synthetic-nsm-retrieval
description: Small synthetic network-and-service-management retrieval set for reproducing EvoClaw's memory comparison. Multi-hop queries require connecting facts spread across two documents. This is self-generated synthetic data (as in the paper); a public-benchmark run (HotpotQA/MuSiQue) is a documented extension in README.md.

documents.title: Edge node telemetry
documents.text: Edge service node ne-7 reports CPU temperature and memory pressure every 30 seconds over MQTT to the orchestrator.

documents.title: Orchestrator alerting
documents.text: The orchestrator raises a thermal alert when an edge node's reported CPU temperature exceeds 80 degrees Celsius for three consecutive samples.

documents.title: Model router fallback
documents.text: The model router marks a model Degraded after three consecutive failures and fails over to the next healthy model in the fallback chain.

documents.title: Router cooldown
documents.text: A Degraded model returns to Healthy after a cooldown of five minutes with no further failures, restoring it to the preferred routing slot.

documents.title: Genome hot-reload
documents.text: Editing genome.toml triggers a hot-reload: the new genome is parsed, validated, and applied while in-flight skill operations quiesce, with no restart.

documents.title: Genome constraints
documents.text: Genome constraints such as max_loss_usd and blocked_actions are inviolable walls that the evolution engine can never mutate.

documents.title: Tiered memory hot tier
documents.text: Hot memory holds the agent's active working context in a compact JSON object capped at five kilobytes, rewritten after every conversation.

documents.title: Tiered memory warm tier
documents.text: Warm memory stores distilled facts with a relevance score and a thirty-day decay half-life; entries below threshold are archived to the cold tier.

documents.title: Evolution rollback
documents.text: After a skill mutation the guarded loop evaluates the candidate and rolls the genome back to the pre-mutation snapshot if fitness regresses beyond the tolerance.

documents.title: Circuit breaker guard
documents.text: The evolution firewall opens a circuit breaker when a mutation drops fitness by more than thirty percent, forcing a rollback regardless of the tolerance.

documents.title: MQTT topics
documents.text: Edge agents communicate on per-node MQTT topics under evoclaw/agents with configurable quality-of-service levels.

documents.title: Cold tier storage
documents.text: Cold memory is the permanent archive in Turso cloud storage, keyed by service identifier and timestamp, queryable but never bulk-loaded into context.

documents.title: Skill parameters
documents.text: The FundingArbitrage trading skill exposes funding_threshold and position_size_usd as evolvable numeric parameters.

documents.title: Fitness weighting
documents.text: The trading fitness score combines a Sharpe component at forty percent, win rate at thirty percent, PnL at twenty percent, and a drawdown penalty at ten percent.

queries.question: How often does edge node ne-7 report telemetry?
When does a Degraded model return to Healthy?
What is the storage cap on the hot memory tier?
Which genome fields are inviolable walls?
At what temperature does ne-7 telemetry trigger a thermal alert?
After how many failures does the router fail over, and how long until the model recovers?
What causes a mutated genome to be restored to its earlier snapshot?
Where do distilled warm-tier facts go once they decay below threshold?
Which parameters of the FundingArbitrage skill can evolve?
How is trading fitness weighted and which skill parameters feed it?
